title: Matrix
author: DeepBuild
description: Matrix(entries) with each entry a vector@1 item from the typeset job, placed onto its cell's center, the centers h_buff apart across and v_buff apart down, inside brackets drawn as paths. a unit is the frame's short side ÷ 8 in u (fw, fh), so the frame is 14.22 × 8 units at 16:9; y flips and the origin moves to the frame's center; radians become degrees; a stroke width w becomes w × unit ÷ 100 u; font_size f is an em of f ÷ 96 units.

entries.about: entries: rows of vector@1 item IDs, one per entry

h_buff.about: the distance between entries' centers across, in units

v_buff.about: the distance between entries' centers down, in units

bracket_h_buff.about: the gap from the outer entries' cells to a bracket, in units (MED_SMALL_BUFF)

bracket_v_buff.about: how far a bracket reaches past the top and bottom rows, in units

move_to.about: move_to: the matrix's center, in units

color.about: the brackets' color; unwritten, the ink role

stroke_width.about: the brackets' width, w × unit ÷ 100 u

params.d: brackets == () ? polyline(xl + serif, yt, xl, (yt + yb) / 2, xl + serif, yb) : polyline(xl + serif, yt, xl, yt, xl, yb, xl + serif, yb)
brackets == () ? polyline(xr - serif, yt, xr, (yt + yb) / 2, xr - serif, yb) : polyline(xr - serif, yt, xr, yt, xr, yb, xr - serif, yb)

refuses.element_to_mobject: Typeset each entry as a vector@1 item with the typeset job, and give its ID.
refuses.element_alignment_corner: Leave it out: each entry is centered in its cell.
refuses.add_background_rectangles_to_entries: Leave it out, or place a rect@1 onto each entry.
refuses.use_vectorized: Leave it out: every math@1 shape is a path the renderer strokes and fills on its own.
refuses.sheen_factor: Leave it out: a flat fill has no sheen; use a gradient fill through the look.
refuses.sheen_direction: Leave it out: a flat fill has no sheen; use a gradient fill through the look.
refuses.background_stroke_width: Leave it out, or draw a second, wider copy beneath in the background color.
refuses.background_stroke_color: Leave it out, or draw a second, wider copy beneath in the background color.
refuses.joint_type: Leave it out: paths join by the look's line style.
refuses.cap_style: Leave it out: paths cap by the look's line style.
refuses.shade_in_3d: Leave it out: 2D shapes draw flat; for a lit shape use math.surface.
